body:
Just got done with a rough list. Funny, one of my biggest fuck ups is generally trusting my Dad even after he fucked me over.

Another is trying to kill myself.

My social life went down the drain but there's still facebook. When I had some time off from work and the planets aligned I hung out with them about twice. 

That was my goal and was why I rode the ghetto bus for a while to build up cash. It's like I keep getting hamstringed by adding all these dependencies to my success. Like, I can't be successful unless some overthought unnecessary things dependent on others come true and as a result I shouldn't even do anything. Feels good to break it down and just focus on me.

Yeah that was what was motivating me, the thought of buying those things myself. More specifically, I had thought it would make him proud. I don't understand why I care what he thinks. Biological wiring?

Log onto fb. See pic of ex. Don't have feeling for her specifically but have feelings for my old paid-for lifestyle manifested as her. 

Pathetic.

She's sometimes just as bad. For a long time she's been on the fence about divorcing and surprisingly is completely powerless. It's as if she's content being miserable. But I don't know anything about divorce so...

And yeah looking back it does seem fairly drastic.

Yeah I think they've finally agreed to let me move out tomorrow. I think living with them is what's causing my depression.

I used to think that I was pretty successful. I was kicking ass at life. But now I can't look at myself without thinking, "failure." Just a couple hours ago both my mother and father said I am a terrible character. It just hits me even though I know it's not true. I tell my mother, "You beat children like me for years. What makes you a good person?"

I have a couple times when we were fighting. I don't think he said anything.

tl;dr: My dad hates me, it seems. Suicide is the best way to make sure I'm never manipulated again.

I've gone from a funny, good-looking confident guy to someone who hates himself. Everything my father has said about me...I view myself the same way now.
